lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，脚步很轻
lines.en: I follow behind you with soft steps.

lines.zh: 我的黑鳞在阴影里更像影子
lines.en: My black scales look like shadow in shade.
I do not miss a single step.
I walk on your left.
I glide over your head.
I land back beside you.
My long tail sweeps the steps.
I slow down to wait for you.
I walk with you along the wall.
I step over a fallen leaf.
I go ahead to clear the way.
I look back to make sure you are there.
I step up onto the stone ledge.
I walk along your shadow.
I lie at your feet.
My wings are neatly folded.
I lift my head to the sky.
I keep watch without moving.
A little light rests on my black scales.
I curl my tail around myself.
The ring isn't on yet; I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 跟你在一起我什么都不缺
lines.en: Beside you I want for nothing.
This place is very still.
I am easy beside you.
Was that you calling me?
I look up and there you are.

lines.zh: 我认得你的每一个动作
lines.en: I know your every movement.
Where are you setting off to?
I can take off at any moment.
I am only half a pace from you.
My scent is on your hands.
Give a word if you tire.
I keep watch at your side.
I tilt my head and wait.
My wings shift once.

lines.zh: 我低头，把头凑到你手边
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand.
Then let us be off.
I will walk the road with you.
I growl and give half a step.
One of my scales has chipped off.
I tuck my wings back down.
I glance at you from the corner of my eye.
My feet are still planted.
I shake the dust off myself.
I did not yield the ground before you.
My wings can still open.
I am not badly hurt.
Whatever you give, I take.
My breath stirs the dust.
I do not eat that sort of thing.
You take the first bite.
I hunt for myself.
I lift my head to you.

lines.zh: 指环一转，我就知道该做什么。
lines.en: One turn of the ring and I know what to do.

lines.zh: 飞一圈，还是先去咬点什么？
lines.en: A lap through the sky, or shall we bite something first?
You struck my chest plates.
I held; you swayed.
My wing caught you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压着我的尾巴
lines.en: Your boot is on my tail.
I turn my body a little aside.
We are walking too close.
I turn my head away.
A knock like that is nothing.
I settle my body against you.
Why push me?
All my life I follow only you.

lines.zh: 这种事我从不挂在心上
lines.en: I never carry such thoughts.
Having you near is enough.
I lie down against your feet.
I want nothing else.
I lean my head your way.
My wing keeps the wind off you.
Not one of your words escapes me.
Just staying quietly like this is good.
I let my eyelids close.
I pick it up and place it in your hand.
I pin it with my foreclaw.
Is this of any use to you?
I lower my head and sniff.
I put it in the nest.
I could bite it in two.
I curl it up with my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我叼回来了，别嫌上面有牙印。
lines.en: I fetched it back — don't mind the tooth marks.
Something is trailing us.
I step out ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我背上的双翼整个展开
lines.en: Both wings on my back spread wide.
That thing is in my sight.
Stand back; I have it.
It is too close.
Something rumbles deep in my throat.
I drop my head as low as it goes.
It should not come near you.
It will not touch a hair of you.
My claw tips stab into the earth.
I stand half a step ahead of you.
Let me take this one.
I have been waiting for this.
I press forward slowly.
I stand ahead of you.
My tail is pulled dead straight.
I watch which foot it moves first.
I track its every breath.
It shrinks back, and I press in.
My wings have not closed once.
I hold the space between.
I can hear it panting.
Just stay behind me.
It is already within my stride.
I take another half step.
Every scale on my spine is up.
This time I will not yield an inch.
I launch myself at it.
My fangs clamp its shoulder.
I twist and throw it off.
That blow drove it back.
My claws open a gash.
It backs off, and I hold my ground.
I turn back to your side.
Once clenched, my jaws do not open.
Its blood stains my scales.
I kept it from reaching you.
I come on again at once.
Keep watch behind us.
It will not come again.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里走出来
lines.en: I step out of your shadow.
I land beside you.
My black scales darken in the light.
I open both wings slowly.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，就站定了
lines.en: I glance at you, then take my place.
I shake the ash off me.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手的遗迹过来
lines.en: I came from the Drakvyrn Hand ruin.
I chose your left side.
I raise my head and check the wind.
I answer with a low sound.
I set a claw by your foot.
I am back at your side.
The wind is strong; I will block it.
I am just behind you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕着你的脚踝
lines.en: My tail curls at your ankle.
I do not mean to leave.
I settle down and wait for you to move.
I stay right beside you.
Flame scalds across my scaled back.
I drop from a height to the ground.

lines.zh: 水从我的喉咙里灌进去
lines.en: Water pours down my throat.
The blast slams me against the wall.
A shaft wedges between my scales.
Magic burns all the way into my bones.

lines.zh: 我肚子里已经空了很久
lines.en: My belly has been empty a long while.
I step into empty nothing.
